cells.gaps: The SeyID e-wallet holding the National ID as a checkable digital card rests only on WISeKey's own 2024 release; no state source shows the authorities accept it as proof of identity, and the state's ID-Wallet page shows a driving licence only.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 23 October 2026 that a method counts only where the state accepts it: the e-wallet's National ID card is shown only by its supplier, WISeKey, so it sets no rung. SeyID, validated against the Civil Status System, gates government e-services on a portal hosting all entities' systems (SYC-004, SYC-002), which is stage 4.
